title: Capacity: full, half full, empty
examples: Teacher, how do I know if it is half full?
Can we use water to show what empty means?
If I pour from this cup to that cup, what happens?

explain.say: Look at the jug. The water comes right up to the top. The jug is full.
Pour some water out. Now the water comes up to the middle. The jug is half full.
Pour all the water out. There is nothing inside. The jug is empty.
Capacity means how much a container can hold. A bucket holds more water than a cup.

draw.text: Capacity: how much it can hold

explain.say: Fill a cup with water and pour it into the jug. Count how many cups fill the jug.

draw.text: How many cups fill the jug?

faq.q: What does it mean if something is empty?
faq.a: It means there is no water or sand inside it at all. You can see nothing inside the container.
asks: Is empty the same as nothing?
What is the opposite of full?

faq.q: How can I show something is half full?
faq.a: Fill it until the water reaches the middle. The bottom half has water, and the top half is empty.
asks: What is half of a cup?
Can you show me half full?

faq.q: When we pour, what are we doing?
faq.a: Pouring means carefully moving liquid from one container to another. We watch where it goes.
asks: What is the action of pouring?

faq.q: How do I know which container holds more?
faq.a: Fill one container with water. Pour it into the other one. If the water spills over, the first one holds more.

faq.q: Is it always easier to see if something is full?
faq.a: Yes, it is easiest to see when it is completely full. You can see the water right up to the top.
asks: Is full the easiest to check?
Can you tell if it is full?

facts: Full means the container is filled right up to the top.
Empty means there is nothing inside the container.
Half full means the container is filled up to the middle.
We use pouring to move liquid from one place to another.

quiz.say: Look at the glass. Tap the word that fits.
quiz.show: 🥛 water right up to the top
quiz.why: The water reaches the top. So the glass is full.

wrong.0: An empty glass has nothing inside, and this glass has water to the top.
wrong.1: Half full means the water reaches the middle, and this water reaches the top.

quiz.say: Look at the jug. Tap the word that fits.
quiz.why: The water reaches the middle. So the jug is half full.

wrong.0: A full jug has water right up to the top.
wrong.2: An empty jug has nothing inside, and this jug has some water.

quiz.say: Look at the two containers. Which one holds more water?
quiz.why: The bucket has more space inside. So the bucket holds more water.

wrong.1: A cup has a small space inside, so it holds less than a bucket.
wrong.2: The bucket is much bigger inside, so they hold different amounts.
